products.quality: Potrace-licensed Trace Image tool; docs and community agree it is clean on high-contrast logos/line art but weak on fine detail; forum consensus workaround is upscaling input before tracing.

Trace Image tool documented with the same dialog/controls as LightBurn's (Cutoff/Threshold, Optimize 0.2 default, Smoothness 0-1.33). No community quality data found for MillMage specifically; same engine as LightBurn inferred [INF].

evidence.cite: Shared LightBurn Software doc infrastructure and identical control set imply the same Potrace-based engine; unverified.

products.quality: Potrace-based Vectorize tool; community rates it well for logos ('best they could find' vs other Potrace tools), but stroke art gets the classic double-line outline problem; optional fill pass documented.

xTool Studio Trace button: Auto-trace outlines color blocks with live blue-line preview. No Studio-specific community quality consensus found; XCS-era comparisons treated LightBurn's trace as the stronger vectorizer. Existence-level only.
Image Trace app (JPG/PNG only); official guidance: best on high-contrast two-tone images. Community reports small lettering traces blurry and low-res clipart works poorly.
No centerline trace as of 2.1; long-standing open feature request (fider) and repeated forum threads confirm absence; users are pointed to Inkscape centerline extensions.

evidence.cite: https://docs.lightburnsoftware.com/2.1/Reference/TraceImage/ (no centerline option listed in the Trace Image dialog)

products.quality: MillMage's Trace Image reference documents the same option set as LightBurn's with no centerline mode listed; absence inferred from the complete documented dialog [INF].

evidence.cite: Doc page enumerates all trace options and none is a centerline mode; no hands-on confirmation.

products.quality: Documented 'centerline' vectorization option producing a single line; official docs themselves say it 'gives less accurate results' than outline mode and has no fill option.
xTool Studio documents a 'Center tracing' mode generating vectors along the centerline of color blocks, aimed at single-color bitmaps and line drawings. Quality unverified by community sources.
No centerline trace; Image Trace offers only outline ('Trace Outlines'). Community threads on single-line text/drawings resolve via external tools (Inkscape centerline trace, Hershey text).

Rich documented dialog: Cutoff+Threshold range sliders, Ignore Less Than, Optimize (0.2 default), Smoothness (0-1.33), Trace Transparency, Sketch Trace, drag boundary select, Fade Image/Show Points, zoom/pan live preview. No named presets documented.

Identical documented control set to LightBurn: Cutoff/Threshold, Ignore Less Than, Optimize, Smoothness, Trace Transparency, Sketch Trace, boundary select, fade/show-points, live preview. No presets documented.

Documented controls: Threshold, Brightness/Contrast, Spot Removal, Smoothing, Optimize, Downsampling, Adaptive Quality, Optimize Travel, optional Filling pass; preview in the import dialog. Utilitarian WinForms UX, no presets documented.

xTool Studio trace interface: live light-blue vector preview over faded source; Fuzziness Threshold (0-255, default 100), Denoising (0-100, default 50), Smoothness (0-1, default 0.8), 'Layer by Color' switch. Fewer knobs than LightBurn.
Minimal documented control set: Threshold, Smoothing, Invert, Trace Outlines; JPG/PNG input only. Simplest UX in the roster; no boundary select, node display, or presets documented.

Limited: trace is explicitly for high-contrast sources; docs warn fine detail converts poorly and route photos to Image (raster) mode. Sketch Trace mode handles unevenly-lit photos of handwriting/sketches via local-contrast edge detection.

Same limited story as LightBurn: Sketch Trace for unevenly-lit sketch photos; docs state results vary with photograph quality and recommend high-contrast sources. No color/multi-tone decomposition documented.

No multi-tone trace: vectorization is single-threshold black/white (brightness/contrast only prep) and docs position it for logos/clean graphics; photos are routed to the grayscale/dithering raster importer instead (a different sector).

Strongest documented multi-tone story in roster: Auto-trace targets multi-color bitmaps and 'Layer by Color' auto-splits traced vectors into per-color layers. Docs warn blurred outlines and dense vibrant colors (photos) are unsuitable.

Minimal: single Threshold binarization of grayscale sources only; official guidance says two-tone/high-contrast works best; community confirms photos and low-res sources trace poorly. No multi-level or color separation.

No documented size limits or performance claims for 2.1. Historical (mostly 1.x-era) community reports of freezes/crashes tracing large or complex images exist; current 2.1 behavior at size unverified.
No documentation or community evidence found on trace robustness or speed with large images in MillMage 0.8.x.

Only product with documented at-size mitigations: Downsampling reduces resolution to kill jaggy noise and Adaptive Quality auto-adjusts detail to job size; docs claim good results 'with any type of image'. Independent speed benchmarks not found.
No documentation or community evidence found on xTool Studio trace behavior with large images or degenerate inputs.

Web SaaS; JPG/PNG only is the sole documented input constraint. No published upload size limit or performance data found; community complaints center on low-resolution inputs, not large-image failures.
